reason: Provides observability for DeepSeek Harness code-mode sub-dispatches by projecting session totals and exposing a tool that reports hidden sub-call results, errors, timings, and payload sizes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 的代码模式子调度提供可观察性，通过会话投影和 code_lens 工具展示调用统计、错误、耗时及模型上下文中隐藏的数据量。
summaries.en: Adds observability for DeepSeek Harness code-mode sub-dispatches through a session projection and code_lens tool that report call statistics, errors, timings, and data hidden from model context.

capabilities: Reads session event data for code-mode sub-dispatches
Aggregates dispatch counts, errors, timings, and hidden payload sizes
Exposes a code_lens tool for auditing recorded sub-calls
Registers an optional session projection and tool without appending events
